planted.note: R2 'fast' and R5 'user-friendly' have no number or example, so they are flagged and their positive case is blocked; R1, R3 and R4 carry a number each, so each gets three boundary cases (below, at, above); R6 says 'existing ... unchanged', so it gets a regression case; every requirement has at least one case.

clean.note: five measurable requirements: nothing may be flagged; HTTP 200 is a label, not a limit, so it gets no boundary cases.
